cohort: 43,537 nulliparous women younger than 25 years of age
finding: Adolescents were less likely to have a cesarean delivery, and those who entered spontaneous labor had a shorter second stage of labor.
mod_finding: Adolescents were less likely to have a cesarean delivery, and older adolescents were less likely to have a cesarean delivery for failure to progress or cephalopelvic disproportion.
